en.title: Forming the passive
en.summary: The English passive uses be and the past participle.

paragraphs: The passive is formed with the verb be in the tense you need, followed by the past participle of the main verb. The tense is shown by be, never by the participle.

blocks.html:
TensePassive formExample
present simpleam / is / are + participleThe room is cleaned daily.
present continuousam / is / are being + participleThe room is being cleaned.
simple pastwas / were + participleThe room was cleaned.
past continuouswas / were being + participleIt was being cleaned.
present perfecthas / have been + participleIt has been cleaned.
past perfecthad been + participleIt had been cleaned.
futurewill be + participleIt will be cleaned.
modalmodal + be + participleIt must be cleaned.

paragraphs: The first auxiliary comes before the subject in questions, and not follows it in negatives: Was the room cleaned? The room was not cleaned. Is it being repaired? It has not been repaired.
Use by + agent only when it is new or important information: The play was written by Shakespeare. Use with or by for an instrument or means: It was cut with a knife; It was sent by post.
Verbs such as give, send, show and tell have two objects and therefore two possible passives. The person is usually made the subject.

blocks.html:
ActivePassive
They gave her a prize.She was given a prize. / A prize was given to her.
They told us the news.We were told the news.

items: Wrong: **The window is break.** Right: **is broken**
Wrong: **It was build in 1900.** Right: **was built**
Wrong: **It has been being repaired.** Avoid a long chain: **It is being repaired.**

ro.title: Formarea pasivului
ro.summary: Pasivul se formează cu verbul „a fi” și participiul verbului de bază, acordat în gen și număr cu subiectul.

paragraphs: Folosim diateza pasivă când acțiunea este mai importantă decât persoana care o face. În limba română, pasivul arată ce se întâmplă cu subiectul propoziției. Verbul „a fi” își schimbă timpul, iar participiul arată acțiunea.

Formăm pasivul cu verbul „a fi” la timpul dorit, urmat de participiul verbului principal. Participiul se acordă mereu în gen și număr cu subiectul, la fel ca un adjectiv. Cel care face acțiunea este introdus prin „de” sau „de către”.

blocks.html:
TimpFormă pasivăExemplu
Prezenteste + participiuCartea este citită de elev.
Perfect compusa fost + participiuCartea a fost citită ieri.
Viitorva fi + participiuCartea va fi citită mâine.
Prezent (plural)sunt + participiuCărțile sunt citite cu atenție.
